Body.Content:
Significant updates are coming to the Power BI service in December, 2018. For example, the preview of Power BI dataflows and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 integration, Power BI solution templates moving to open source, and updates to natural language query.

For more information, see the Power BI blog.
